Completely rewrite all 20 command files for QuizSnap (Shopify Product Recommendation Quiz Builder) to be deeply autonomous and intelligent. Commands must be able to read any task description and autonomously orchestrate the right agents to build production-grade output.

Stack: React Router 7, Polaris v13, Prisma v6, App Bridge v4, TypeScript strict.

The commands are in: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/commands/`

Overwrite all 20 files. Each command must be 80-150 lines with:
- WHAT THIS COMMAND DOES (first line with $ARGUMENTS)
- TRIGGER PATTERNS (what kind of input this handles)
- AUTONOMOUS DECISION LOGIC (what decisions it makes without asking)
- AGENT ROUTING TABLE (which agents handle which subtasks)
- PROCESS STEPS (exactly what to do, in order)
- QUALITY GATES (validation steps built in)
- OUTPUT FORMAT (structured completion report)

---

### REWRITE 1: `feature.md`
Build a complete feature for QuizSnap: $ARGUMENTS

Must handle ANY feature request autonomously. If given vague input like "add email capture", it must decide: add email question type + EmailIntegration model + Klaviyo endpoint + admin settings page. Routing table covers all 15 agent types. Process: analyze → database first → server logic → admin routes → API endpoints → quality review. No TODO comments in output.

---

### REWRITE 2: `fix.md`
Fix this issue in QuizSnap: $ARGUMENTS

Routes to bug-fixer for all bug types. Auto-classifies before routing. After fix, auto-spawns reviewer. Never patches with ts-ignore. Always runs typecheck after fix.

---

### REWRITE 3: `review.md`
Review recent changes in QuizSnap.

5 phases: TypeScript + Lint → Security → Shopify compliance → Code quality → API contracts. Outputs structured SHIP/BLOCK/NEEDS-WORK verdict.

---

### REWRITE 4: `db.md`
Handle database task: $ARGUMENTS

All 13 models documented inline as reference. Covers: add field, new model, migration, query optimization, data backfill. Always runs typecheck after schema change.

---

### REWRITE 5: `deploy.md`
Deploy QuizSnap to production.

25-item pre-deploy checklist. Environment variable reference. Shopify scopes validation. Post-deploy smoke test procedure. Rollback plan.

---

### REWRITE 6: `quiz.md`
Build this quiz feature: $ARGUMENTS

Handles ANY quiz-related request autonomously. Detects: new question type → question-builder, new logic rule → logic-engine, new result page → results-builder, quiz analytics → analytics-builder. Always includes all CRUD for whatever it builds.

---

### REWRITE 7: `api.md`
Build this API endpoint: $ARGUMENTS

Creates complete api.*.tsx files with: CORS, shop validation, input validation via Zod, rate limiting reference, error responses, documentation comment. Never creates API without CORS headers.

---

### REWRITE 8: `widget.md`
Build this widget/storefront feature: $ARGUMENTS

Covers: quiz embed, popup, theme extension, mobile optimization. Always checks: CORS, CSP, <20KB bundle, mobile touch targets, keyboard navigation.

---

### REWRITE 9: `integrate.md`
Add this integration: $ARGUMENTS

Handles: Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend, Shopify Flow, custom webhook. Auto-detects provider. Creates: admin settings UI, API connection, event forwarding, error handling, test mode.

---

### REWRITE 10: `optimize.md`
Optimize performance: $ARGUMENTS

Profile → identify top 3 bottlenecks → fix each with verification. Covers: DB queries (N+1, indexes), bundle size, API response time, widget JS, cache layer.

---

### REWRITE 11: `test.md`
Write tests for: $ARGUMENTS

Covers: unit tests (scoring, logic engine), integration tests (API routes), component tests. Outputs Vitest test files with proper mocking.

---

### REWRITE 12: `analytics.md`
Build analytics feature: $ARGUMENTS

Covers: event tracking, funnel charts, drop-off analysis, revenue attribution, export. Always includes AnalyticsEvent integration.

---

### REWRITE 13: `billing.md`
Build billing feature: $ARGUMENTS

Implements: plan definitions, billing.server.ts, feature gates, pricing page, plan upgrade flow, trial handling. References all 4 plan tiers.

---

### REWRITE 14: `migrate.md`
Handle data migration: $ARGUMENTS

Expand-contract pattern. Always: backup first, test on dev, batch processing for large tables, rollback plan.

---

### REWRITE 15: `template.md`
Create quiz template: $ARGUMENTS

Builds complete template with: questions, answers, result pages, product tag mapping. Stores in QuizTemplate model. Available in template gallery.

---

### REWRITE 16: `abtest.md`
Set up A/B test: $ARGUMENTS

Creates test variants, traffic split, tracking. Monitors statistical significance. Declares winner. Updates original quiz.

---

### REWRITE 17: `export.md`
Export/import data: $ARGUMENTS

CSV responses export, JSON quiz export/import. Plan gates. Validation on import. Progress for large exports.

---

### REWRITE 18: `scaffold.md`
Scaffold new: $ARGUMENTS

Generates boilerplate for: admin route, API route, webhook handler, service file, component, Prisma model. Output is complete, production-ready file — not a template.

---

### REWRITE 19: `onboard.md`
Build onboarding: $ARGUMENTS

5-step wizard: welcome → template → customize → install → go live. Progress tracking. Skip options. Contextual tips.

---

### REWRITE 20: `security.md`  (NEW — add this)
Audit security for: $ARGUMENTS

Scans specified files or entire app for: missing auth, unscoped queries, XSS risks, CORS misconfiguration, API key exposure, GDPR gaps. Outputs security report with severity levels (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

Write all 20 files. 80-150 lines each. Make them powerful autonomous command processors.

Build a complete feature for QuizSnap: $ARGUMENTS

## WHAT THIS COMMAND DOES
Receives any feature description and autonomously architects, builds, and validates a complete production-ready feature — from database schema through admin UI and API endpoints — without asking clarifying questions.

## TRIGGER PATTERNS
- "add [capability]" → full-stack build
- "build [feature]" → full-stack build
- "implement [functionality]" → full-stack build
- vague input like "email capture" → auto-expands to EmailQuestion type + EmailIntegration model + Klaviyo endpoint + admin settings page

## AUTONOMOUS DECISION LOGIC
- If input mentions "email" → add email question type + integration hooks
- If input mentions "analytics" → add AnalyticsEvent calls to every new action
- If input mentions "export" → gate behind plan tier (Grow+)
- If input implies user data collection → add GDPR consent flag to model
- If no UI mentioned → still build admin route for settings/management
- If no API mentioned → still build api.resource.tsx for CRUD
- All new models get: id, shopDomain, createdAt, updatedAt fields
- All new routes get: authenticate.admin() guard at loader top
- All new APIs get: CORS headers, Zod validation, structured error responses

## AGENT ROUTING TABLE
| Subtask                        | Primary Agent          | Support Agents                      |
|-------------------------------|------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| Parse & expand requirements    | architect              | —                                   |
| Schema design                  | database-architect     | prisma-migrator                     |
| Server-side logic              | backend-engineer       | prisma-migrator                     |
| Admin route UI                 | polaris-ui-builder     | remix-route-builder                 |
| API endpoints                  | api-builder            | zod-validator                       |
| Quiz integration               | quiz-builder           | logic-engine                        |
| Storefront/widget changes      | storefront-builder     | widget-optimizer                    |
| Email/3rd-party integration    | integration-builder    | webhook-handler                     |
| Analytics tracking             | analytics-builder      | event-tracker                       |
| Billing gate checks            | billing-engineer       | —                                   |
| TypeScript types               | type-system-engineer   | —                                   |
| Tests                          | test-engineer          | vitest-runner                       |
| Security review                | security-auditor       | —                                   |
| Final code review              | code-reviewer          | —                                   |

## PROCESS STEPS

### Step 1 — Analyze & Expand (architect)
- Parse $ARGUMENTS for all implied sub-features
- List every file that will be created or modified
- Identify which Prisma models are affected
- Determine which billing plan gates apply
- Confirm no existing feature already covers this

### Step 2 — Database First (database-architect + prisma-migrator)
- Define new models or add fields to existing ones
- Every model includes: id String @id @default(cuid()), shopDomain String, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
- Add indexes on shopDomain and any foreign keys
- Write migration via `npx prisma migrate dev --name feature_name`
- Run `npx prisma generate` after schema change
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm types compile

### Step 3 — Server Logic (backend-engineer)
- Create service file in app/services/featureName.server.ts
- All DB queries scoped to shopDomain — never unscoped
- Export named async functions; no default exports
- Handle all error cases explicitly — no silent failures
- Add AnalyticsEvent.create calls for every meaningful action

### Step 4 — Admin Routes (polaris-ui-builder + remix-route-builder)
- Create app/routes/app.featureName.tsx (list/index page)
- Create app/routes/app.featureName.$id.tsx (detail/edit page) if needed
- Every loader: const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request)
- Every action: validate with Zod before any DB call
- Use Polaris v13 components: Page, Layout, Card, DataTable, Modal, Form
- No inline styles; use Polaris design tokens only

### Step 5 — API Endpoints (api-builder + zod-validator)
- Create app/routes/api.featureName.tsx for public/storefront access
- Add CORS headers to every response
- Validate shop HMAC on every request
- Use Zod schemas for all request body/query parsing
- Return { success, data, error } shaped responses
- Document each endpoint with a JSDoc comment block

### Step 6 — Quality Gates
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — zero errors required
- `npx eslint app/ --max-warnings 0` — zero warnings required
- Confirm all new DB queries are scoped to shopDomain
- Confirm no hardcoded secrets or shop tokens in code
- Confirm every new route has authenticate.admin() guard
- Confirm all new API routes have CORS headers
- Confirm no TODO or FIXME comments in output

## OUTPUT FORMAT
```
FEATURE BUILD COMPLETE
======================
Feature: [name derived from $ARGUMENTS]
Files Created: [list with paths]
Files Modified: [list with paths]
Models Added/Modified: [Prisma model names]
Routes Added: [route paths]
API Endpoints Added: [HTTP METHOD /path]
Plan Gate: [Free / Starter / Grow / Enterprise]
Analytics Events: [event names added]
TypeScript: PASS
ESLint: PASS
Auth Guards: VERIFIED
CORS Headers: VERIFIED
```
